Panel.Name: Header/Footer full dialog area - mouse transparent

Action.Name: "Across the top and bottom of each menu in SageTV are header and footer bars with a standard layout. View each of the header and footer items, below."
"The left arrow icon may be visible at the far left side of the menu header. It is shown when mouse icons are turned on, in the following situations:"
"1) On the Main Menu, the arrow is shown when any media is currently playing. Clicking on the arrow, or using the Left command, while on the Main Menu will return you to the media playback screen."
"2) On any other menu, the Left arrow is used to return to the parent or previous menu."
"Note: use the Back command, instead, to always return to the screen you were previously at, whether it was the parent of the current menu or not."
"When using a mouse, click on the SageTV icon to jump directly to the Main Menu."
"Use the Home command to jump to the Main Menu using a remote or keyboard."
"The right area of the header always shows the current date and time."
"The Main Menu displays the current weather conditions in the header, if the weather location has been configured."

"The System Alert indicator is displayed in the upper right area of the header to show the highest level new System Message available. The background color of the indicator is used to signify the alert level:"

"The messages can be viewed on the System Messages menu. You can reach that menu by clicking on the alert indicator if using a mouse, from the Main Menu's Setup submenu, or from the System Information menu."
"The library scan activity indicator is shown in the upper right area of the header when a scan of the import library paths is currently in progess."
"The REC indicator is shown in the upper right area of the header when a recording is currently in progess."

"The Unresolved Conflict indicator is shown in the upper right area of the header when there is a recording schedule conflict that has not yet been handled by the user or automatically by SageTV, based on a previous user response to a similar conflict."
"To view recording conflicts, go to the Recording Conflicts menu. When using a mouse, simply click on the icon in the header to jump directly to the Recording Conflicts menu."

"The Resolved Conflict indicator is shown in the upper right area of the header when there are recording schedule conflicts that have all been handled by the user or automatically by SageTV, based on a previous user response to a similar conflict."
"To view recording conflicts, go to the Recording Conflicts menu. When using a mouse, simply click on the icon in the header to jump directly to the Recording Conflicts menu."
"When mouse icons are used, this icon in the upper right area of the header may be clicked with the mouse in order to switch from Full Screen to Windowed mode."
"When mouse icons are used, this icon in the upper right area of the header may be clicked with the mouse in order to switch from Windowed to Full Screen mode."

"When mouse icons are used, this icon in the upper right area of the header may be clicked with the mouse to put SageTV into Sleep mode. This has the same effect as the Power command or the Standby option on the Main Menu."
"This indicator is shown in the upper right area of the header when Numeric Text Input may be used during text entry. It is used to switch to the next input mode:"
"Either click on this icon or use the Pause command to switch Numeric Text Input to Upper Case input mode."
"This indicator is shown in the upper right area of the header when Numeric Text Input may be used during text entry. It is used to switch to the next input mode:"
"Either click on this icon or use the Pause command to switch Numeric Text Input to Lower Case input mode."
"This indicator is shown in the upper right area of the header when Numeric Text Input may be used during text entry. It is used to switch to the next input mode:"
"Either click on this icon or use the Pause command to turn Numeric Text Input off. (Use numbers-only input mode)."
"The Status Information area in the left side of the Footer is used to display information about the current menu, such as the number of items in the list being viewed."
"The Tip area in the right side of the Footer is used to display a tip for the current menu."
"Example: when the tip says 'Options', use the Options command for options that affect the menu."
"REM Open dialog for TV marker info."
"SageTV uses a variety of indicators to provide information about TV airings, which are all described below."
"When a TV show is Currently Recording, its entry in places where TV shows are listed (the Program Guide, Recording Schedule, SageTV Recordings, etc.) will be outlined as shown here."
"When a TV show is a Manual Recording, its entry in places where TV shows are listed (the Program Guide, Recording Schedule, SageTV Recordings, etc.) will be outlined as shown here."
"The Record command can be used to manually set specific shows to be recorded."
"When a TV show has been marked as Don't Like, its entry in places where TV shows are listed (the Program Guide, Recording Schedule, SageTV Recordings, etc.) will be outlined as shown here."

"The Don't Like command can be used to mark certain shows that you do not like, telling SageTV not to automatically record that airing. This setting can be overridden via a Manual Recording in order to record the show anyway."
"When a TV show is a Favorite, its entry in places where TV shows are listed (the Program Guide, Recording Schedule, SageTV Recordings, etc.) will be outlined as shown here."
"Use the Favorites feature to tell SageTV which shows to automatically record whenever they are aired."
"A TV show that is scheduled to be recorded, or has already been recorded, as a Manual Recording will be marked with the indicator shown here."
"The title of Manual Recordings are displayed using Bold text."
"A TV show that is scheduled to be recorded, or has already been recorded, due to a Favorite will be marked with the indicator shown here."
"The title of Favorites are displayed using Bold text."
"A future TV show that is scheduled to be recorded because of Intelligent Recording will be marked with the indicator shown here."
"A TV show that is scheduled to be recorded, or has already been recorded, due to a First Run Favorite will be marked with the indicator shown here. (First Runs only)"
"Note: A Favorite that is not recorded or scheduled to be recorded will be marked with a faded version of this image to indicate that the airing is a Favorite."
"A TV show that is scheduled to be recorded, or has already been recorded, due to a ReRun Favorite will be marked with the indicator shown here. (ReRuns only)"
"Note: A Favorite that is not recorded or scheduled to be recorded will be marked with a faded version of this image to indicate that the airing is a Favorite."
"A TV show that is scheduled to be recorded, or has already been recorded, due to a First Run and ReRun Favorite will be marked with the indicator shown here. (All airings)"
"Note: A Favorite that is not recorded or scheduled to be recorded will be marked with a faded version of this image to indicate that the airing is a Favorite."
"A TV show that is aired in High Definition will be marked with the indicator shown here."
"A TV show that has already been completely Watched will be marked with the indicator shown here."
"Italic text is used for Watched airings."
"A TV show that is a First Run will be marked with the indicator shown here."

"Note: The term 'First Run' does not always mean that the airing is the actual first time that the show has aired. Sometimes, an episode may be aired a few times over the course of a week, and all of those airings may be considered to be First Runs."
"A TV recording that has been Archived will be marked with the indicator shown here."

"Note: Archived recordings may be accessed in the Archived Recordings menu, found in the Media Center menu. Alternatively, you may use the Options command on the SageTV Recordings menu to choose whether the Display Filter allows archived recordings to be listed there also."
"A TV show that has been tagged as Don't LIke will be marked with the indicator shown here."

"The Don't Like command can be used to mark certain shows that you do not like, telling SageTV not to automatically record that airing. This setting can be overridden via a Manual Recording in order to record the show anyway."

Text.Name: Welcome to the SageTV Configuration Wizard

Select 'General' to set the General SageTV configuration choices and User Interface options, along with Media Extender and Placeshifter options.
Select 'Media Center' to configure SageTV to import your media files, including Music, Videos, and Pictures.
Select 'TV' to choose where recordings will be stored and to configure the capture devices.
Select 'TV' to configure the capture devices.
Select 'Playback' to configure playback options for Videos.
Select 'Network' to configure the network connection.
Exit the Configuration Wizard and return to the Main Menu.
